# The documentation site's generator and what it needs, at exact versions.
#
#   uv run inv docs-live   # preview at http://localhost:9000
#   uv run inv docs        # what CI runs
#
# Zensical is a tool that builds the site (docs/, zensical.toml). It is not a
# dependency of the package and is not in uv.lock: the tasks (tasks.py) and the
# workflow (.github/workflows/docs.yml) run it with
# `uvx --constraints .github/docs-constraints.txt zensical`. It is pre-1.0:
# change the versions on purpose, with
#
#   echo "zensical==<version>" | uv pip compile - --universal --python-version 3.11 --no-header --no-annotate
#
# and look at the built site afterwards.
click==8.5.0
deepmerge==3.0.1
jinja2==3.1.6
markdown==3.11
markupsafe==3.0.4
pathspec==1.1.1
pygments==2.21.0
pymdown-extensions==12.2
pyyaml==6.0.3
tomli==2.5.0
zensical==0.0.70
